g.text: Layer anatomy of the switch: what the bridge word's change moves, through which part
47.8 sweep, test half (another item moved, locker-first).
x = layer / depth. Grey columns: the whole change switches < 30% of the reader (not read). Dotted line = L.
Thin grey = a random part of the same share. UNVERIFIED.
